"""Wrapper script to copy data and run training."""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess

# In Databricks, workspace files are accessible at /Workspace/Users/...
# The current working directory for a job is typically /databricks/driver
workspace_path = "/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab3f14e0/data"

# Copy data files to current directory
try:
    shutil.copy(f"{workspace_path}/train.csv", "./train.csv")
    print("Copied train.csv")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error copying train.csv: {e}")
    raise

try:
    shutil.copy(f"{workspace_path}/score.csv", "./score.csv")
    print("Copied score.csv")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error copying score.csv: {e}")
    raise

# Copy the training script
script_path = "/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab3f14e0/scripts/train_model.py"
try:
    shutil.copy(script_path, "./train_model.py")
    print("Copied train_model.py")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error copying train_model.py: {e}")
    raise

# Run the training script
print("Running training script...")
result = subprocess.run(["python", "./train_model.py"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
print("STDERR:", result.stderr)
print("Training completed successfully!")

      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "# Read data from workspace files\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "# Read the CSV files from workspace\n",
        "train = pd.read_csv('/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab3f14e0/data/train.csv')\n",
        "score = pd.read_csv('/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab3f14e0/data/score.csv')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Training logic from train_model.py\n",
        "FEATURES = ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4', 'f5']\n",
        "LEARNING_RATE = 0.1\n",
        "ITERATIONS = 300\n",
        "\n",
        "X = train[FEATURES].to_numpy(dtype=float)\n",
        "y = train['label'].to_numpy(dtype=float)\n",
        "w = np.zeros(X.shape[1], dtype=float)\n",
        "b = 0.0\n",
        "for _ in range(ITERATIONS):\n",
        "    p = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-(X @ w + b)))\n",
        "    g = p - y\n",
        "    w = w - LEARNING_RATE * (X.T @ g) / len(y)\n",
        "    b = b - LEARNING_RATE * g.mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "Xs = score[FEATURES].to_numpy(dtype=float)\n",
        "preds = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-(Xs @ w + b)))\n",
        "out = pd.DataFrame({'row_id': score['row_id'], 'score': np.round(preds, 6)})\n",
        "out.to_csv('/databricks/driver/predictions.csv', index=False)"
      ]
    }
  ],
